domains.name: Reusable Skill Engineering
domains.scope: Select distinct reusable procedures, generalize specialized workflows, and design independent behavioral checks with truthful evidence.

skills.name: repertoire-gap-selection
skills.description: Choose useful additions to a skill repertoire by comparing decisions, required evidence, and deliverables against existing procedures.

skills.name: specialized-workflow-generalization
skills.description: Turn an authorized specialized workflow into reusable instructions by preserving decision invariants and moving changing or case-specific facts into inputs and verification steps.

skills.name: skill-forward-test-design
skills.description: Design independent new tasks and checkable assertions to evaluate a skill, while separating test specifications, actual execution evidence, and unresolved reliability limits.
